content.short: OpenEden is a premier RWA protocol that tokenizes US Treasury Bills, providing secure institutional-grade yield.
content.description: OpenEden is a leading decentralized finance platform specializing in the tokenization of high-quality real-world assets (RWAs), with a primary focus on US Treasury Bills. Its flagship TBILL token allows participants to earn secure yields from US government debt in a transparent, non-custodial environment. As the first RWA protocol to receive an institutional-grade "A-bf" rating from Moody’s, OpenEden sets a high standard for security. Operating across major networks like Ethereum and the XRP Ledger, it provides robust infrastructure for a more efficient and interconnected global financial system.
